description: Check whether a cached audit result exists and is still fresh for this target.

cacheFile.description: Path to cache file (default: .a11y-cache.json in project root)

filePaths.description: Array of file paths to check against the cache

maxAgeDays.description: Treat entries older than this many days as expired and needing re-scan. Default: no expiry

useContentHash.description: Use SHA-256 content hash instead of size+mtime (more reliable but slower). Default: false

name: check_audit_cache

path.description: A file this call wrote or read, when there is one.

version.description: Version of an external tool, when relevant.

title: Check Audit Cache
